mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TB_DELETED_MEMBER D ON M.MEMBER_NO = D.MEMBER_NO WHERE D.MEMBER_NO IS NULL

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName , M.BIRTHDAY , M.PHONE , M.EMAIL , M.IMAGE , M.MEMBER_ROLE AS memberRole , M.ENROLL_DATE AS enrollDate FROM TB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TB_DELETED_MEMBER D ON M.MEMBER_NO = D.MEMBER_NO WHERE D.MEMBER_NO IS NULL ORDER BY M.MEMBER_NO DESC

SELECT M.MEMBER_NO , M.MEMBER_NAME , M.BIRTHDAY , M.PHONE , M.EMAIL , M.IMAGE , M.MEMBER_ROLE , M.ENROLL_DATE FROM TB_MEMBER M LEFT JOIN TB_DELETED_MEMBER D ON M.MEMBER_NO = D.MEMBER_NO WHERE D.MEMBER_NO IS NULL
AND ( M.MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_NO DESC
